title: Policy-driven suggestion enactor with simulated canary and ops checklist
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Summary: Build a policy-driven service (enactor) that safely applies Optimize's batching/caching recommendations with a preflight simulation canary and an operator checklist for manual approvals. This ticket owns the runtime-side enactor, the simulation harness that runs suggested config through a traffic-mirroring sandbox, and the minimal ops UI prompts for approval/rollback hooks. Goals: 1) reduce per-token cost by safely applying cache/batching suggestions, 2) avoid user-visible regressions via simulated canaries and deterministic rollback triggers, 3) provide traceable approvals and audit logs for every applied suggestion. Scope: - Enactor service to receive suggestions from Optimize and validate policy constraints (SLOs, model compatibility, account tiers). - Simulation canary: traffic-mirroring into a sandbox runtime to estimate latency, p99, and output divergence vs baseline using a fixed evaluation set. - Apply workflow: staged rollout policies (percent-based progression), automated health checks, and explicit ops checklist items before final 100% commit. - Rollback: automated rollback triggers (latency spike, error-rate, quality drift) with fast revert path and post-mortem scaffold. Out of scope: UI mockups beyond simple prompts; deep ML eval tooling (will integrate existing eval service).
acceptance_criteria: Enactor accepts suggestion payloads and runs policy validation (model compatibility, min-seq-length, quantization-safe).
Simulation canary executes a mirrored subset of traffic and produces a report (latency, p50/p95/p99, token cost delta, and semantic divergence score) within 30 minutes for typical suggestion sizes.
Staged rollout controller can advance a suggestion through 0%->5%->25%->100% based on configurable health gates and time windows.
Automated rollback triggers are implemented: latency increase >20% p99 for >5 minutes, error-rate >2x baseline for >3 minutes, or semantic divergence above threshold on evaluation prompts.
All applied changes are logged with request IDs, approver metadata, and a link to the simulation report; logs are queryable in Console for at least 90 days.
Minimal ops checklist UI (Console modal or Slack flow) exists and requires explicit approver confirmation before final 100% step for customer-impacting suggestions.
End-to-end test suite covers policy validation, simulation harness, staged rollout progression, and rollback execution in CI (flaky tests <1% of runs).
implementation_plan: Week 1: Define policy schema and gate rules; align on thresholds with PM/RE to set safe defaults.
Week 2: Implement enactor API and policy validator; stub simulation harness and mirror pipeline.
Week 3: Build simulation canary runner and reporting (latency/cost/divergence metrics); add storage for reports.
Week 4: Implement staged rollout controller with configurable steps and health-check listeners; wire automatic rollback signals.
Week 5: Integrate ops checklist (Console modal + Slack webhook) and audit logging; add RBAC checks for approvers.
Week 6: End-to-end testing, perf tuning, and rollout in internal env; collect metrics and iterate on thresholds.
Post-launch: Observe on pilot customers, refine heuristics, and add ML-eval integration for quality monitoring.
progress_updates: 2026-03-02: Kickoff meeting with PM (Noah Ruiz) and RE (Maya Chen). Agreed on default thresholds: p99 latency delta 20%, error-rate 2x baseline, semantic divergence 0.08 (cosine-based).
2026-03-05: Policy schema RFC posted to Confluence (link below). Validator PoC implemented; currently rejects suggestions that require unsupported kernels or negative seq-length assumptions.
2026-03-09: Simulation runner prototype built; mirror pipeline handles 1% sampled traffic in staging. Early reports show cost delta estimates within 7% of observed for short prompts.
2026-03-12: Staged rollout controller MVP can progress steps via CLI. Need Console integration and approver RBAC before internal pilot.
2026-03-14: Security review triage completed; no immediate blockers. Logged follow-up on audit retention to SREs.
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Simulation may not accurately reflect tail p99 under real traffic patterns — Mitigation: require >24h mirror runs for high-impact suggestions before 100% commit and conservative default gates.

Risk: False positives on semantic divergence due to nondeterministic sampling — Mitigation: use a fixed evaluation prompt set and aggregate across multiple seeds; include human-in-the-loop for high divergence alerts.
Risk: Approval fatigue if too many suggestions require manual approval — Mitigation: tier suggestions by estimated customer impact and allow whitelisting for low-impact accounts.
Risk: Rollback thrashing during noisy signals — Mitigation: require sustained violation windows and cooldown periods before reattempts; exponential backoff on retries.
